answer: Trust here is climbed, not claimed. A fresh identity starts at the nadir and must earn graded, passing work across many epochs before it reaches the summit where its votes carry real weight. Newly minted sybils all crowd the same low ledge, unable to lift one another upward, because only already-established non-kin peers can raise a newcomer's work to finality. Time under scrutiny is the cost a swarm cannot fake.
